name: SM3
description: A compact SM3-style adaptive optimizer factory with elementwise second-moment scaling.

examples.title: Minimize a quadratic bowl with SM3
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.sm3 import sm3

params = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(3.0)), torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(-2.0))]
optimizer = sm3(params, lr=0.05)
for _ in range(20):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = sum((p - target).square() for p, target in zip(params, (1.0, 4.0)))
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
